text:
alex-marketing: quick one  can eng/runtime run a tiny smoke to validate the webinar benchmark bundle for our launch post? Need schema sanity, sample coverage, and a headliner median+p95 for gen + embed. Target path: s3://redwood-prod/benchmarks/webinar/2026-04/samples/. Aim: 300 samples, reproducible command, raw CSVs, and one PNG summary. Can you also check float vs 8-bit quant and report any dropped rows?

jamie-eng-runtime: ack. we can do that. do you want observed seq distribution or a controlled seq=512 comparison too? also caching: prefix cached vs cold?

alex-marketing: observed distribution for the main numbers + one controlled seq512 run for apples-to-apples. show prefix_cached vs cold. Hardware callout needed. EOD PT would be great but not required if infra busy.

lucy-eng-runtime: i'll run it. plan: deterministic 300-sample pull (first shard), runs: observed & seq512, modes: float32 + 8bit, cache: cold + prefix_cached. will emit counts: total_rows, dropped_rows_schema, truncated_rows. reproducible snippet:

```
# quick smoke
tools/bench/run_smoke.sh \
  --s3 s3://redwood-prod/benchmarks/webinar/2026-04/samples/ \
  --sample 300 \
  --model redwood-medium-v1 \
  --seq-dist observed \
  --controlled-seq 512 \
  --quantized both \
  --cache-modes cold,prefix_cached \
  --truncate 8192 \
  --output gs://bench-results/webinar/1955501234/
```

bench-bot: Job queued: id=jb-20260401-9101, queue_pos=4, est_start=10m.

jamie-eng-runtime: small flag  some older shards have a nested "context" object; we'll detect and drop those rows but include examples in the bucket. also will limit long contexts to avoid OOM.

lucy-eng-runtime: quick update  run finished. uploaded: gs://bench-results/webinar/1955501234/{smoke-300.csv, smoke-512.csv, methods.txt, slide.png}. Highlights: gen median=36ms/token, gen p95=120ms/token; embed median=11ms, embed p95=26ms. 8-bit quant speedup ~1.7x (median gen). dropped_rows_schema=4/300, truncated_rows=2/300. cold vs cached p95 ratio ~1.9x. Used A40 pool for main runs, A100-80GB for quant checks.

frank-ops: noted the A40/A100 callouts  ops confirms time window used.

alex-marketing: perfect  can you add a tiny CSV with top-5 examples where quantization changed tokens/outputs for comms review and drop a 1-paragraph methods blurb? then i'll pull the slide. thanks!! :tada:

lucy-eng-runtime: done  top5-quant-affected.csv and methods.txt in the bucket. marking resolved unless you want more sweeps. :white_check_mark:
